spec.note:
TASK (practice): BoilPot. Goal as in the instruction. <item> = one of: pot, water pot, kettle, saucepan. The object starts on/near: counter. <target> = stove. Then actuate: stove / stove knob.
RULE 1 (run-to-end): the episode reward is the FINAL state. Wrap EVERY action call in try/except; never raise, exit or return early; on any sensor failure use a fallback point; never let the arm end inside/buried in an object (after every open or close near a surface, lift the arm up first). Keep it short: ONE perception pass per object, no retry loops.
RULE 2 (move the object!): a program that moves the target object even if it fails to finish earns MORE than one that does nothing. Prefer a robust grab: descend 6cm above the object along its grasp axis, close, lift 15cm. If the mask is empty (<40 px) try the next synonym.
RULE 3 (actuate the fixture even if you cannot see the result): after placing the object, drive the named fixture/part: approach it, and press it down ~2cm then release, then drag it 4cm sideways and back (repeat for 2-3 candidate knob/button spots if the mask is empty, using fallback points on the fixture).
Perception helper to use: def M(t,rgb):
 for p in (t, t+" metallic", t+" object"): r=segment_sam3_text_prompt(rgb,p); if r and r[0]["mask"].sum()>=40: return r[0]["mask"]
 pt=point_prompt_molmo(rgb,t)
 if isinstance(pt,dict) and t in pt: u,v=pt[t][0]; m=np.zeros(rgb.shape[:2],bool); m[max(0,v-45):v+45,max(0,u-45):u+45]=1; return m
 return None
Centroid 3D of a mask: ys,xs=np.where(mask); u,v=int(xs.mean()),int(ys.mean()); d=depth[v,u]; if d is None or d<=0.05 or d>2.5: None else world point via the depth formula.
API (only these exist): navigate_to(name); get_observation() -> {"robot0_robotview":{"images":{"rgb","depth"},"intrinsics","pose_mat"}}; segment_sam3_text_prompt(rgb,text)->list of {"mask","score"} or []; point_prompt_molmo(rgb,text)->{text:[[u,v],...]} or "There are none"; plan_grasp(depth,intr,seg)->(poses Nx4x4 CAMERA-frame grasp poses, scores); solve_ik(pos[3] world, quat_wxyz[4] world)->joint targets; move_to_joints(j); open_gripper(); close_gripper(). Depth is METRES. pixel(u,v) depth d -> cam 3D x=(u-cx)*d/fx, y=(v-cy)*d/fy, z=d; world = pose_mat @ [x,y,d,1]. pose_mat is 4x4 (camera->world). Grasp poses from plan_grasp are in CAMERA frame -> world = pose_mat @ grasp.
ORDER for a pick-and-place: (1) navigate_to(the GRASP surface where the object currently is), grab+lift the <item>; (2) navigate_to(the <target>), find its surface point, lower 8cm above it open, release, lift; (3) navigate_to(<fixture>) and actuate the <fixture-part> per RULE 3; (4) final: move up 0.2m, open gripper. For a task where the object starts INSIDE a fixture (fridge/drawer/cabinet/toaster), first open that fixture, then grab, then the rest.
